vulns.description: ### Impact Any optional non-boolean CLI arguments (e.g. `--delim`, `--buf-size`, `--manpath`) are passed through python's `eval`, allowing arbitrary code execution. Example:  ```sh python -m tqdm --manpath="\" + str(exec(\"import os\nos.system('echo hi && killall python3')\")) + \"" ```  ### Patches https://github.com/tqdm/tqdm/commit/4e613f84ed2ae029559f539464df83fa91feb316 released in `tqdm>=4.66.3`  ### Workarounds None  ### References - https://github.com/tqdm/tqdm/releases/tag/v4.66.3
